title: Public privacy, cookies, help, and terms pages
summary: Guests and signed-in users can now open branded Privacy, Cookies, Help, and Terms pages in MyAPES Core, and reach them from the footer, register, and other public chrome.
changes: Add branded /privacy, /cookies, /help, and /terms pages with APES CIC notices and a short Help guide.
Link those pages from the site footer, register, sidebar Help, and the profile privacy notice fallback.
affected_areas: Register, footer, sidebar, and profile chrome
version_rationale: Patch release: adds the missing public policy and help routes without changing sign-in, consent capture, or account permissions.
validation: PHPUnit PublicLegalPagesTest covers branded content on all four routes, signed-in public access, public chrome links, and the guest privacy contact path.

PHPUnit HealthAndThemeTest, ChangeLogPageTest, MascotHelperTest, PublicAccountLifecycleTest, and AccountLifecycleReadinessTest cover footer links, Help tip, the privacy notice fallback, and deploy preflight accepting the in-app /privacy page.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Register still does not record a consent timestamp. That remains a separate issue.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove the public policy and help routes and their chrome links.
provenance: Public privacy, cookies, help, and terms pages for issue #123, pull request #204.
